title: Servex crash at 00:31 fixed; agents now revive after a crash

owner_note.text: The 00:31 crash was an unhandled promise rejection in the voice page write queue; it is fixed, and a stray rejection is now logged instead of killing Servex. A boot with no fresh snapshot now revives working or idle agents that have an open task (the earlier crash had marked every agent stopped on its way down, so nobody came back). Browser tests are fenced from the live Servex, and a flaky "No route" from the worktree proxy no longer refuses merges. Alternative: only revive from a shutdown snapshot; I chose also to revive from crashed rows because a crash leaves no snapshot.
